2. **Albany, Georgia**: Albany, Georgia, has a city population that has been in decline in recent decades, currently sitting around 69,000 residents.

Given that Albany, New York, is already very close to or has fluctuated around the 100,000 mark as a city, and Albany, Georgia, is currently much smaller (around 69,000) and experiencing population decline, Albany, Georgia, will not reach one hundred thousand occupants before Albany, New York.
